changelog:
Initial release of gasless-crosschain-executor skill.

- Enables local-key swap planning and execution for EVM chains with bundled paths: cross-chain (1inch Fusion+ gasless), same-chain gasless (1inch Fusion), and same-chain paid (1inch Aggregation Router v6).
- Strictly enforces local-only key custody and never shares or exposes private keys or sensitive wallet information.
- Provides decision tree for workflow selection (quote, execute, monitor, recover, or bootstrap) and safe swap execution.
- Details robust safety and approval handling standards with clear refusal of unsafe actions.
- Includes wallet bootstrap workflow for generating and securing new wallets locally.
- Offers utilities and instructions for resolving open-ended swap requests and verifying token and chain selection.
